title: How to remove things from shop menu?

posts.author: DeyJay5
posts.body:
I would like to remove the circled items from the show menu screen:
I would like it just to say "Buy" and "Cancel" and I would like the stats info on the right gone as well, so it just has "Posession". Any help is appreciated. Thank you so much.

posts.author: Howard_Bentley
posts.body:
@DeyJay5
Here you go! Just insert this into your script list.
Ruby:
class Window_ShopCommand < Window_HorzCommand
 
  def col_max
    return 2
  end

  def make_command_list
    add_command(Vocab::ShopBuy,    :buy)
    add_command(Vocab::ShopCancel, :cancel)
  end
end

class Window_ShopStatus < Window_Base
 
  def refresh
    contents.clear
    draw_possession(4, 0)
  end
end
